title: litmus artifact envelope, format_version 1
description: Point-in-time evidence published by capture_artifact. The envelope remains open for additive fields within version 1; data is the observation, including explicit null, and never a viewer-computed verdict.

format_version.description: Artifact-envelope version. A consumer reads this field first and refuses a version it was not written for.

type.description: The capture's declared artifact type, used to group observations.

timestamp.description: The observation's timezone-aware UTC timestamp, rendered with Z.

data.description: The complete JSON observation. Null is explicit evidence, not an unavailable capture.

identity.description: Artifact's full-string identity alphabet. The end assertion also refuses a trailing newline, which a bare dollar anchor can admit.
